'''Mynock mud pies''' were a dish made with [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]],<ref name="bap" /> a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="mynock">{{DB|creature|mynock|mynock}}</ref> They were [[Currency/Legends|sold]] at the concession areas of [[Aucellis Park]], which was located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Keriba VI]]. Despite being closed, the areas were fully stocked with [[Foodstuff/Legends|foods]] such as Mynock mud [[Pie/Legends|pie]] and [[Nerfburger/Legends|Nerf burgers]].<ref name="bap" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mynock mud pies were mentioned in "[[Beneath Aucellis Park]]," a ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' mini-adventure authored by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]] and published on the [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Wizards.com|website]] on [[August 21]], [[2003]].<ref name="bap" />
